phase_2_react_issues.issue: CRITICAL: useCallback dependency array missing 'coupons'. toggleCoupon() captures stale 'coupons' from outer scope. When coupons change, the callback still references old coupons, causing state to revert or show incorrect data.
MEDIUM: Key fallback chain (variant.id ?? _id ?? slug ?? code ?? variant.name) is fragile. If all fail silently, React re-renders list incorrectly. The name fallback is also not unique.
phase_2_react_issues.fix: Always ensure variant.id exists. Add validation in MenuItem model to guarantee variant.id is never undefined.

phase_2_react_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Badge motion component uses key={badge} which changes on every render when badge is a number. This causes unnecessary re-mounts.
phase_2_react_issues.fix: Use a stable key like `badge-${badge}` or use useId() from React.

phase_2_react_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Cart component imported with ssr: false but wrapped in dynamic(). When Cart loads, useCart() might be called while context is initializing, causing potential hook errors.
phase_2_react_issues.fix: Ensure CartProvider is fully initialized before Cart component mounts. Consider adding fallback UI.

phase_2_react_issues.issue: MEDIUM: useEffect in Lightbox has dependency on multiple callback functions (onClose, onNext, onPrev). If parent component is re-rendered frequently, the listeners will be re-added constantly.
phase_2_react_issues.fix: Stabilize callbacks with useCallback in parent component or pass stable references.

phase_2_react_issues.issue: LOW: Date.now() used as part of variant ID. While unique in this session, not ideal for stable keys across sessions. Use crypto.randomUUID() instead.
LOW: MenuItem ID generated with Date.now(). If two items added in same millisecond, IDs collide. Use crypto.randomUUID().
LOW: Badge key uses string template with position. Could be optimized to just use index or stable ID.
phase_2_react_issues.fix: Add id field to badge objects or use stable identifier.

phase_2_react_issues.issue: MEDIUM: useCallback for isInWishlist depends on 'wishlist' array, causing function reference to change on every wishlist update. This can cause unnecessary re-renders in child components using this function.
phase_2_react_issues.fix: Remove 'wishlist' from dependencies and use a closure pattern, or memoize the entire context value.

phase_3_nextjs_issues.issue: CRITICAL: No Suspense boundaries around async components. AdminSidebar and AdminTopbar could cause issues with dynamic rendering. No error.tsx exists.
phase_3_nextjs_issues.fix: Wrap components with Suspense and create error.tsx and not-found.tsx files for admin routes.

phase_3_nextjs_issues.issue: HIGH: Dynamic route file exists but no generateStaticParams() implemented. This could cause ISR/SSG optimization issues.
phase_3_nextjs_issues.fix: Create generateStaticParams() function to pre-generate popular product pages.

phase_3_nextjs_issues.issue: MEDIUM: No metadata export. Login page should have specific metadata but uses root layout only.
phase_3_nextjs_issues.fix: Add export const metadata = {...} at the top of page.tsx

phase_3_nextjs_issues.issue: MEDIUM: No metadata export. Signup page needs specific metadata.
phase_3_nextjs_issues.fix: Add export const metadata = {...} at the top of page.tsx

phase_3_nextjs_issues.issue: MEDIUM: No metadata or protected route check. Profile pages should not be statically generated.
phase_3_nextjs_issues.fix: Add 'use client' and authentication guard, or mark as dynamic.

phase_3_nextjs_issues.issue: MEDIUM: No metadata export for dashboard.
HIGH: Missing error.tsx and not-found.tsx files across most routes. Global error handling is missing.
phase_3_nextjs_issues.fix: Create app/error.tsx and app/not-found.tsx with proper fallback UI.

phase_3_nextjs_issues.issue: MEDIUM: No loading.tsx files with Suspense boundaries. Customer-facing pages may not have proper loading states.
phase_3_nextjs_issues.fix: Create loading.tsx files with skeleton loaders for key routes.

phase_3_nextjs_issues.issue: MEDIUM: AdminProvider and CartProvider are 'use client' providers in root layout. This is correct but should be in a separate client component.
phase_3_nextjs_issues.fix: Extract providers to separate 'use client' component: app/providers.tsx

phase_4_database_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Variant subdocument id is generated with ObjectId().toString() but never validated to be unique within variants array. Could lead to duplicate variant IDs within a menu item.
phase_4_database_issues.fix: Add validation or use built-in _id field for subdocuments.

phase_4_database_issues.issue: HIGH: CartItem subdocument references MenuItem via ObjectId, but no validation that MenuItem exists. Could create orphan references.
phase_4_database_issues.fix: Add pre-save hook to validate MenuItem references or use ref with proper cascade.

phase_4_database_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Payment method 'id' field has unique: true in a subdocument array. This constraint applies globally, not per-user, causing issues when multiple users add payment methods.
phase_4_database_issues.fix: Remove unique constraint from subdocument. Use (user._id, paymentMethod.id) compound index if needed.

phase_4_database_issues.issue: LOW: basePrice field is optional but no validation ensures either basePrice or variants exist. Could save item with neither.
phase_4_database_issues.fix: Add custom validation in schema: at least one of basePrice or variants must exist.

phase_4_database_issues.issue: MEDIUM: GET orders doesn't populate user/menu references. If Order model has refs to User/MenuItem, this causes N+1 queries when rendering full order details.
phase_4_database_issues.fix: Use .populate() if needed or ensure Order.lean() is intentional for admin list view.

phase_4_database_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Cart subdocument default is () => ({}) which creates empty object. If items array is accessed before initialization, could cause undefined behavior.
phase_4_database_issues.fix: Default to () => ({ items: [] }) to ensure items array always exists.

phase_4_database_issues.issue: LOW: Text index on (name, description) not analyzed carefully for performance. Description field could be very large.
phase_4_database_issues.fix: Limit description length for text index or use separate index.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: CRITICAL: Two separate login endpoints with different implementations. Admin uses /admin/api/login, Customer uses /api/auth/login. This duplication creates maintenance burden and security inconsistency.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Consolidate into single /api/auth/login endpoint that routes based on email domain or type parameter. Use /api/admin/login as deprecated alias.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: HIGH: Rate limiting uses IP address which may be spoofed behind proxy. Need to trust X-Forwarded-For but also validate.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Use combination of IP and session ID for rate limiting, or require CSRF token.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: HIGH: No rate limiting on admin login! Brute force attack vector. Customer login has rate limiting (5/min) but admin doesn't.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Add rate limiting to admin login: rate limit by email + IP, 5 attempts per 60 seconds.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: MEDIUM: JWT fingerprint only includes last 20 chars of password hash. If password is changed, fingerprint should invalidate old tokens, but implementation relies on passwordVersion field.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Verify passwordVersion is always incremented on password change. Add check in all auth endpoints.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Admin JWT implementation not reviewed yet but likely mirrors customer JWT. Need to verify same security checks.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Review adminJwt.ts for same fingerprint, expiry, and validation logic.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Logout endpoint exists but need to verify it clears cookies properly and doesn't leave session data.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Verify logout deletes BOTH customer_session cookie and any refresh tokens.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Refresh endpoint exists but need to verify it validates old token before issuing new one.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Verify refresh validates the old JWT signature and fingerprint before issuing new token.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: MEDIUM: /api/auth/me endpoint should only return authenticated user. Need to verify auth guard is present.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Ensure route uses isCustomerJwtAuthed() before returning user data.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: HIGH: Routes like /api/user/*, /api/orders need to verify JWT before processing. Check all protected routes have auth guards.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Audit all protected routes for presence of isCustomerJwtAuthed() or isAdminJwtAuthed() checks.

phase_5_auth_issues.issue: MEDIUM: Password hashed with bcrypt cost 10. During signup, user is immediately logged in with setCustomerSession(). Verify this doesn't create session before user is fully persisted.
phase_5_auth_issues.fix: Add error handling to rollback session if user.save() fails.
